gloss.intro: The words developers (an the AI teams) uise, in plain language.
gloss.switch.help: Wirds wi a dottit unnerline get a plain explanation whan ye hover ower them.
gloss.backlog.text: The waitin list o ideas an wark no plannit in yet, wi the maist important at the tap. Nocht there gets warked on till it muives tae Tae dae.
gloss.sprint.text: A short, fixed stretch o wark (aften ane or twa weeks, niver mair than a month) wi a goal an an agreed set o cairds tae feenish.
gloss.standup.text: A quick daily check-in: whit ilka team member did, whit they dae next, an whit's stoppin them. In Scrum it's caad the daily scrum.
gloss.bug.text: Somethin that disnae wark the wey it should.
gloss.test.text: A check that somethin warks the wey it should. Some tests the computer rins by itsel ilka time the code chynges; ithers are you tryin a feenished caird afore ye accept it.
gloss.commit.text: A saved snapshot o the code, wi a short note o whit chynged. Ye can aye gang back tae ane.
gloss.push.text: Sendin yer saved snapshots (commits) frae this computer tae the shared copy online, sic as GitHub, sae they're backed up an ithers can get them.
gloss.branch.text: A separate line o wark in the code, sae chynges can be made wioot touchin the main version.
gloss.merge.text: Jynin the chynges frae ae branch intae anither, usually back intae the main version.
gloss.repo.text: The project's folder o code wi its fu history o commits. It can live on yer computer, on GitHub, or baith.
gloss.refactor.text: Tidyin the code wioot chyngin whit it dis: smaller files, clearer names, less repetition.
gloss.deploy.text: Copyin a new version o the software on tae the computers that rin it, sic as a test copy or the live service.
gloss.kanban.text: A wey o warkin whaur cairds muive across a board's columns (like Tae dae, Gaun on, Duin) an the team limits hou muckle is in progress at aince, sae wark keeps flowin.
gloss.wip.text: WIP is short for wark in progress. A WIP limit is the maist cairds a column should hauld at aince, sae the team feenishes things afore stertin mair.
gloss.pr.text: Askin for a branch's chynges tae be checkit an merged intae the main version. Some sites caa it a merge request.
gloss.hook.text: A wee command that rins by itsel at a set meenit, for example whan an AI session stairts, sae the team hears yer comments.
gloss.token.text: The wee pieces o text an AI reads an writes, aboot three quarters o a wird ilk. AI uise is coontit in tokens, sae fewer tokens leave mair o yer plan.
gloss.agent.text: An AI that warks on a task by itsel: reads the code, maks chynges, rins checks an reports back. Its wark still gets checkit.

gloss.title: 📖 Wirds explained
gloss.about: Free trainin in plain leid: ilka wird ye meet frae a first idea tae a service fowk rely on, wi Agile, biggin, keepin it safe an warkin wi AI alang the wey.
gloss.about.noai: Free trainin in plain leid: ilka wird ye meet frae a first idea tae a service fowk rely on, wi Agile, biggin an keepin it safe alang the wey.
gloss.g.team: 🤝 Warkin as a team (an wi AI)
gloss.card.text: Ae bit o wark: a job, a bug or an idea. It muives across the columns till it's duin.
gloss.project.text: A board for ae thing ye want duin, like an app, a gairden shed or a trip. It haulds the cairds.
gloss.forteam.text: The column for cairds that are the team's turn again, for example efter ye answered their question or speired for a chynge.
gloss.lead.text: The AI helper in chairge o a project. It taks up yer cairds, shares oot the wark, an speirs at ye whan it needs ye.
gloss.agentprog.text: The AI program on yer computer, like Claude Code, that the board starts whan there's wark for yer helpers.
gloss.dispatcher.text: The pairt o the board that reads a new caird or comment an decides wha taks it up. Simple rules first, a wee AI only whan it's no shair.
gloss.space.text: A group o projects that belang thegither, like a folder for boards. 🪐 marks ane.
gloss.playground.text: A ready-made project for a pal tae try AI-gile in, wi an invite code tae send them.
gloss.hyperfocus.text: 🎯 Shaws jist ae project an yer messages, sae nocht else pulls at ye. The teams cairry on as normal.
gloss.qa.text: Short for quality assurance: aathin duin tae mak shair wark is richt afore it gaes live. In AI-gile that means the automatic checks: whan QA is reid, somethin failed, an it cannae gae live till that's fixed.
gloss.release.text: A named bundle o feenished wark that gaes live thegither, wi short notes on whit chynged. 🚀 Releases writes the notes fae the duin cairds.
gloss.rollback.text: Gaun back tae the last version that warked whan a new ane causes trouble. In AI-gile, Roll back gethers the undo steps written on ilka chynge intae ae checklist.
gloss.live.text: The real version that fowk uise, no a copy fer tryin things oot. Developers cry it production an aw.
gloss.change.text: A planned chynge tae somethin fowk rely on, written doon first: whit, how come, the risk, when, an how tae undae it. Stert ane wi 🔀 Raise a chynge.
gloss.risk.text: Somethin that could gang wrang, scored on how likely an how bad it wid be. ⚠️ Risks keeps them in ae list, heichest score first, ilk ane wi a date tae look again.
gloss.chgwin.text: The times when chynges may gang live, like a quiet Tuesday nicht. Ootside a windae a chynge caird cannae be feenished, unless it's an emergency.
gloss.gonogo.text: A last check jist afore a chynge gaes live: ilka body that has tae approve says Go or No go. It only gaes ahead whan aabody says Go.
gloss.approval.text: Waitin on an aye afore wark sterts. A caird a pal raises, or a chynge, waits in ✅ Approvals till ye approve or decline it.
gloss.quiettime.text: A stretch o time, like durin a live stream, a demo or owernicht, whan nocht gaes live. The teams keep warkin an testin, but gaun live waits till it ends. Elsewhaur it's caad a change freeze.
gloss.service.text: Somethin ye biggit that fowk rely on, like a website or an app, lookit efter sae it keeps wirkin. Tick “This project is a service” an say whit it offers, wha uises it an wha's on call.
gloss.uptime.text: An automatic check, ilka few minutes, that yer service still answers. If it fails a wheen o times in a row, AI-gile opens an incident caird by itsel.
gloss.statuspage.text: A public page that shows whether a service is wirkin (green, orange or red) wi the latest update, sae the fowk that uise it can check insteid o speirin.
gloss.incident.text: Somethin that's broken or no warkin properly for the fowk uisin it richt noo, like the wabsite bein doun or gey slaw. A 🔥 incident caird jumps the queue: gettin it warkin again comes first.
gloss.major.text: A muckle incident: lots o fowk hit, or siller or data at risk. Ae button pits ilka team on it (swarm), wauks whaever's on call an asks fer a status update ilka 30 minutes.
gloss.oncall.text: Bein the ane that answers when somethin breks, even at nicht. Ilka service has an on-call team member that's waukit first fer its incidents.
gloss.replyby.text: How lang a caird may wait fer a first answer, for example an oor fer an incident. Efter that it gets a red clock, sae nocht is quietly forgot. Cried a response target an aw.
gloss.postmortem.text: A short look back efter an incident: whit happened, whit helped an whit tae chynge, wi'oot blamin onybody. An incident cannae be closed wi'oot ane.
gloss.problem.text: The hidden cause ahint ane or mair incidents. A 🧩 problem caird gethers incidents that keep comin back, sae the cause is fund an fixed fer guid.
gloss.rootcause.text: The real reason somethin broke, no jist whit ye saw gaun wrang. Fix the root cause an the incident stops comin back.
gloss.workaround.text: A wey tae keep things wirkin till the real fix is ready, like restertin somethin when it gets stuck. It's written on the problem caird sae naebody has tae wark it oot again.
gloss.knownerror.text: A problem whase cause is unnerstuid but isnae fixed yet, usually wi a workaround written doun. 🧩 Known errors lists them, sae aabody uises the workaround instead o diggin again.
gloss.runbook.text: Step-by-step instructions fer fixin a kent kind o bother, sae it's duin the same wey, quick, ilka time. Efter a muckle incident the team can propose ane fer ye tae OK.
gloss.backup.text: A saved copy o yer data fae afore, tae faw back on if somethin's lost or damaged. AI-gile maks a backup o yer boards ilka day.
gloss.restore.text: Pittin data back fae a backup. A backup only really coonts aince ye ken it can be restored, sae it's worth tryin noo an again.
gloss.dod.text: The team's short checklist o whit “feenished” means, like testit an explained, afore a caird is haundit tae ye. Its twin, the Definition o Ready, says when a caird is clear eneuch tae stert.
gloss.testpile.text: The feenished cairds waitin fer ye tae try, ane efter anither. Accept ane or send it back wi a note, an the next ane comes up.
gloss.retro.text: A regular look back at hou the team warks, tae agree on ane or twa things tae dae better next time. Short for retrospective. In AI-gile a retro suggests a chynge tae the team's weys o warkin, an ye say Go or No yet.
gloss.peerreview.text: A second pair o een: somebody ither than the author checks the wark afore it reaches ye, sae fewer mistaks get throu. In AI-gile anither AI checks ilka caird.
gloss.swarm.text: Aa haunds on deck: mony fowk drap ither wark tae fix ae urgent thing thegither till it's sortit. In AI-gile ilka team helps on ae project, an ither projects wait the while.
gloss.scrummaster.text: In Scrum, the body that helps the team wark weel: clears whit blocks them, keeps meetins on track an coaches guid habits, wioot bossin onybody. In AI-gile the Lead Scrum Master spots stuck cairds, nudges the teams an minds ye o whit's waitin, across ilka project.
gloss.scrummaster.text.noai: In Scrum, the body that helps the team wark weel: clears whit blocks them, keeps meetins on track an coaches guid habits, wioot bossin onybody. Wioot AI, AI-gile's version spots stuck cairds an warks wi fixed commands, like sortin Tae dae.
gloss.discovery.text: The early stage o findin oot whilk problem's worth solvin an for wha, afore onythin gets biggit.
gloss.problemstmt.text: Ane or twa sentences sayin wha has a problem, whit it is an why it matters, sae ilkane aims at the same thing.
gloss.user.text: A body that uises whit ye build. Their needs are whit the wark is for.
gloss.stakeholder.text: Onybody that cares hou the wark turns oot or is affectit by it, like the fowk peyin for it, uisin it or supportin it.
gloss.persona.text: A made-up but lifelike body that staunds for ae kind o user, sae the team can spier “wad Sam fin this easy?”
gloss.userresearch.text: Speakin tae an watchin real fowk tae lairn whit they need, raither than guessin.
gloss.journey.text: The steps a body taks tae get somethin duin, frae first hearin aboot it tae feenishin, an aa ootside yer product. Drawin it oot shaws whaur they get stuck.
gloss.painpoint.text: Somethin that annoys or slaws fowk doun the day. Guid products tak pain points awa.
gloss.assumption.text: Somethin ye believe but hinnae checked yet. Writin assumptions doun shaws whit tae test first.
gloss.hypothesis.text: A best guess ye plan tae check, wi whit ye expect tae happen, like “fowk'll sign up if the first month's free”.
gloss.experiment.text: A wee planned test tae lairn if an idea warks, afore ye bet a lot on it.
gloss.poc.text: A quick rough try tae see if an idea can wark at aa. It's usually thrawn awa aince ye hae the answer.
gloss.prototype.text: An early model o the product, aften clickable pictures, tae try the idea on fowk afore biggin it properly.
gloss.wireframe.text: A simple sketch o a screen shawin whaur things gae, wioot colours or real content.
gloss.mockup.text: A detailed pictur o hou a screen'll look, wi real colours an text, but nocht warks yet.
gloss.bizcase.text: The reasons for daein a project: whit it costs, whit it brings in or saves, an the risks.
gloss.feasibility.text: Whether somethin can really be biggit an lookit efter wi the time, siller an skills ye hae.
gloss.outcome.text: The chynge ye want for fowk, like fewer missed appointments. It matters mair than hou muckle ye build.
gloss.output.text: Somethin the team maks, like a new screen or a report. Makin it disnae automatically mean it helps onybody.
gloss.successmetric.text: A nummer that tells ye if the wark did whit it wis for, like mair fowk feenishin their order.
gloss.kpi.text: An important nummer ye watch tae see if things are gaun weel, like sign-ups a week.
gloss.okr.text: A wey o settin goals: the objective says whit ye want, an a wheen key results are the nummers that shaw ye got there.
gloss.product.text: The thing bein biggit an lookit efter for its users, sic as an app, a wabsite or a tool.
gloss.vision.text: A short statement o wha the product helps an whaur it's heidin in the lang run.
gloss.po.text: The body that decides whit gets biggit an in whit order, sae the team aye warks on whit matters maist. In AI-gile that's you.
gloss.pm.text: The body that looks efter a product's direction: whilk problems it solves, for wha an why. PM can an aa mean project manager, sae check whilk.
gloss.projmgr.text: The body that keeps a project on time an on budget, trackin wha daes whit an by whan.
gloss.roadmap.text: A rough plan o whit's comin ower the next months, in order. It shaws direction, no exact dates, an chynges as ye lairn.
gloss.milestone.text: A pynt in a project worth markin, like “first version live” or “100 users”.
gloss.mvp.text: The smaaest version o a product that's still uisefu tae real fowk, sae ye can lairn frae them early.
gloss.requirement.text: Somethin the feenished product maun dae or be.
gloss.scope.text: Whit's includit in the wark an, jist as important, whit's no.
gloss.scopecreep.text: Whan mair an mair gets addit tae the wark bit by bit, wioot onybody agreein the extra time or cost, sae it niver quite feenishes.
gloss.feature.text: Ae thing the product can dae for fowk, like “reset yer passwird”.
gloss.epic.text: A muckle bit o wark, ower big for ae go, sae it's split intae smaaer cairds.
gloss.story.text: A wee bit o wark written frae the user's side: “As a shopper, I want tae save my basket, sae I can feenish later.” It stairts a blether aboot whit tae build.
gloss.ac.text: The checks ae caird maun pass tae coont as duin, agreed afore wark stairts, like “the basket's still there efter I log oot an back in”.
gloss.task.text: A single job tae be duin, aften ae wee step o a bigger story.
gloss.ticket.text: Anither wird for a caird: ae bit o wark or ae request, trackit frae stert tae feenish.
gloss.priority.text: Hou important or urgent somethin is compared wi aathin else, sae the maist important wark gaes first.
gloss.prioritise.text: Pittin wark in order o importance. A common wey is MoSCoW: Must have, Should have, Could have, Won't have this time.
gloss.estimate.text: A best guess at hou big or hou lang a bit o wark is. It's a guess, no a promise.
gloss.storypoints.text: A wey o guessin the size o wark by comparin cairds wi ilk ither (“aboot twice as big as that ane”) raither than in oors. They're no for comparin teams.
gloss.tshirt.text: Guessin the size o wark as S, M, L or XL. Quick an guid eneuch for early plannin.
gloss.poker.text: A gemm for estimatin: ilkane shaws a size caird at the same time, then the heichest an laichest explain why.
gloss.dependency.text: Whan ae bit o wark cannae stert or feenish till anither does.
gloss.blocker.text: Onythin stoppin wark frae muivin forrit richt noo, like a missin answer or a broken tool.
gloss.deadline.text: The date somethin maun be feenished by.
gloss.deliverable.text: Somethin concrete the wark produces an hauns ower, like a warkin page or a report.
gloss.forecast.text: A prediction o whit's likely tae happen, like whan the wark'll be duin, based on whit ye ken sae far.
gloss.metric.text: Onythin ye measure an track ower time, like page visits or hou lang a fix taks.
gloss.feedback.text: Whit fowk tell ye aboot yer wark, guid an bad. Gettin it early an aften is the hert o Agile.
gloss.agile.text: A wey o warkin in wee steps: build a wee bit, shaw real results aften, lairn frae whit fowk say an chynge the plan as ye gae, raither than plannin aathin afore ye stert.
gloss.manifesto.text: A short statement written in 2001 by software makkers. It pits fowk, warkin results, close wark wi customers an respondin tae chynge afore hivvy plans an paperwark.
gloss.waterfall.text: The aulder wey o warkin: plan aathin, then build it aa, then test it aa, ae stage efter anither. Chynges late on are hard an costly.
gloss.iteration.text: Ae roond o biggin somethin, checkin it an improvin it. Agile wark is a chain o thir, an a sprint is ae kind.
gloss.increment.text: A new warkin bit addit tae the product in a sprint or roond o wark, that fits wi whit wis there afore.
gloss.scrum.text: A popular Agile wey o warkin: a wee team warks in short sprints towards a goal, wi set roles an a wheen regular meetins tae plan, check an improve.
gloss.scrumteam.text: The wee group that daes the wark in Scrum: a product owner, a Scrum Master an the developers.
gloss.ceremonies.text: The regular meetins in Scrum: sprint plannin, the daily scrum, the sprint review an the retro. Mony fowk caa them ceremonies.
gloss.sprintplan.text: The meetin at the stert o a sprint whaur the team agrees why the sprint matters, whilk cairds tae tak on an hou tae stert.
gloss.sprintgoal.text: Ae sentence sayin whit a sprint is for. Wee tasks can chynge alang the wey, sae lang as the goal is met.
gloss.sprintbacklog.text: The cairds pickit for the current sprint, wi the team's plan for daein them.
gloss.productbacklog.text: The hail ordered list o aathin that micht be biggit for the product, maist important at the tap. It keeps chynging as ye lairn.
gloss.productgoal.text: The bigger result the product is warkin towards, that helps the team choose whit tae dae next.
gloss.refinement.text: Regularly gaun throu the backlog tae tidy, split, order an add detail tae cairds, sae they're ready tae pick up. Caad backlog grooming an aa.
gloss.sprintreview.text: A meetin at the end o a sprint whaur the team shaws whit it feenished an hears whit fowk think, tae decide whit comes next.
gloss.demo.text: Shawin feenished wark warkin, live, tae the fowk that speired for it.
gloss.timebox.text: A fixed amoont o time for somethin. Whan it rins oot ye stop, even if no aathin's duin.
gloss.velocity.text: Hou muckle wark a team usually feenishes in a sprint, uised tae plan hou muckle tae tak on next time. It's no a score for hou hard fowk wark.
gloss.capacity.text: Hou muckle wark the team can tak on in a period, efter holidays an ither jobs.
gloss.burndown.text: A chart o the wark left in a sprint gaun doun day by day. If the line bides flat, somethin's stuck.
gloss.burnup.text: A chart o feenished wark gaun up ower time, nixt tae the total plannit, sae ye can see whan ye'll get there.
gloss.kanbanboard.text: The board itsel: a column for ilka stage o the wark, wi cairds muivin across.
gloss.pullsys.text: A wey o warkin whaur new wark only stairts whan somebody has room tae tak it on, raither than bein pushed on tae a fu plate.
gloss.flow.text: Hou smooth wark muives across the board. Guid flow means cairds keep muivin raither than pilin up.
gloss.leadtime.text: Hou lang it taks frae somebody speirin for somethin tae it bein feenished.
gloss.cycletime.text: Hou lang a caird taks frae whan wark really stairts on it tae whan it's feenished.
gloss.throughput.text: Hou mony cairds get feenished in a week, or in ony set time.
gloss.bottleneck.text: The ae stage whaur wark piles up an slaws aathin ahin it, like the narrae neck o a bottle.
gloss.swimlane.text: A raw across the board that groups cairds o ae kind, sic as urgent wark or ae team's cairds.
gloss.lean.text: A wey o warkin that cuts oot waste (onythin that disnae help the customer) an keeps wark flowin.
gloss.waste.text: In Lean, onythin that taks effort but disnae help the customer, like waitin, rework or biggin things naebody uises.
gloss.kaizen.text: Gettin a wee bit better aa the time throu wee regular chynges, then checkin they helped. Retros are ae wey tae dae it. Caad kaizen an aa.
gloss.selforg.text: A team that decides for itsel hou tae dae the wark, raither than bein telt step by step.
gloss.crossfunc.text: A team that has aa the skills it needs tae feenish the wark itsel, like design, biggin an testin.
gloss.spike.text: A short, timeboxed bit o research tae answer a question afore committin tae the real wark.
gloss.rework.text: Daein wark again cause it wisnae richt the first time.
gloss.safe.text: Weys o uisin Agile across mony teams in a big organisation. SAFe (the Scaled Agile Framework) is ae weel kent example.
gloss.code.text: The written instructions that tell a computer whit tae dae. Caad source code an aa.
gloss.proglang.text: A leid for writin code, sic as JavaScript, Python or Java. Different anes suit different jobs.
gloss.developer.text: Somebody that writes an chynges code. Caad a programmer or software engineer an aa.
gloss.software.text: Programs that rin on computers an phones, as opposed tae the machines themsels (the hardware).
gloss.app.text: Short for application: a program fowk uise tae get somethin duin, on a phone, a computer or in a web browser.
gloss.webapp.text: An app that rins in a web browser, sae there's nocht tae install.
gloss.frontend.text: The pairt o an app ye see an click on: the screens, buttons an wirds, aften in yer browser.
gloss.backend.text: The ahin-the-scenes pairt o an app that keeps the data an daes the wark whan ye click somethin, like checkin yer passwird.
gloss.fullstack.text: Warkin on baith the front end an the back end.
gloss.ui.text: Whit a body sees an uises on screen: layoot, buttons, menus an text.
gloss.ux.text: Hou it feels tae uise somethin: easy, clear an pleasant, or confusin an slaw.
gloss.accessibility.text: Makkin things uisable by aabody, includin fowk that cannae see weel, cannae uise a moose or uise a screen reader.
gloss.responsive.text: Makkin pages fit an wark weel on ony screen size, frae a phone tae a big monitor.
gloss.designsys.text: A shared kit o colours, fonts, buttons an rules, sae ilka screen looks an behaves the same wey.
gloss.architecture.text: The owerall shape o a system: whit the main pairts are an hou they talk tae ilk ither.
gloss.database.text: An organised store o information, like a gey pooerfu spreadsheet that the app can read an chynge.
gloss.schema.text: The layoot o a database: whilk tables o information it has an whit gaes in ilka ane.
gloss.sql.text: Short for structured query language: the leid uised tae spier at mony databases for information or tae chynge it.
gloss.data.text: Information kept by a computer, like names, orders or settins.
gloss.server.text: A computer that's aye on an answers requests frae ither computers, like sendin a web page whan ye visit it.
gloss.client.text: The side that speirs for somethin, usually yer browser or app, speakin tae a server. In business it can jist mean a customer an aa.
gloss.api.text: Short for application programming interface: a set menu o requests ae program can mak o anither, like speirin at a weather service for the day's forecast.
gloss.endpoint.text: Ae item on an API's menu: a web address a program can caa tae get or send somethin.
gloss.integration.text: Connectin twa systems sae they wark thegither, like yer shop sendin orders tae yer accoonts software.
gloss.webhook.text: A message ae system sends tae anither by itsel the meenit somethin happens, like “payment received”.
gloss.library.text: Ready-made code somebody else wrate that ye can reuise instead o writin it yersel.
gloss.framework.text: A ready-made structure for biggin an app that decides muckle o hou the code is laid oot, like a hoose frame ye fill in.
gloss.sdk.text: A kist o tools, code an examples for biggin software for ae platform or service.
gloss.softdep.text: A library or tool yer code needs tae wark. Keepin them up tae date matters for safety.
gloss.package.text: A bundle o ready-made code ye can install an uise in a project.
gloss.pkgmgr.text: A tool that fetches an updates the packages yer code depends on. npm is a common ane.
gloss.git.text: The maist widely uised tool for keepin the history o code chynges, as commits an branches.
gloss.github.text: A wabsite that keeps Git repos online, sae teams can share code, review chynges an track wark.
gloss.vcs.text: Keepin a fu history o ilka chynge tae the files, sae ye can see wha chynged whit an gae back if needit. Git daes this.
gloss.clone.text: Makkin yer ain fu copy o a repo, wi its history, on yer computer.
gloss.pull.text: Fetchin the latest commits frae the shared copy (like GitHub) on tae yer computer. The opposite o push.
gloss.mainbranch.text: The official version o the code that aabody warks frae, aften caad main or master.
gloss.conflict.text: Whan twa chynges touch the same lines in different weys, sae the computer cannae jyne them an a body has tae choose.
gloss.diff.text: A view shawin exactly whit chynged atween twa versions: lines addit an lines taen awa.
gloss.fork.text: Yer ain copy o somebody else's repo, that ye can chynge wioot affectin theirs.
gloss.script.text: A short program that daes ae job by itsel, like tidyin files or stairtin the app.
gloss.build.text: Turnin the code intae somethin ready tae rin, or the ready-tae-rin result itsel.
gloss.compile.text: Translatin code fowk wrate intae a form the computer can rin directly.
gloss.cli.text: A text windae whaur ye type instructions for the computer instead o clickin. Caad the terminal an aa.
gloss.config.text: The settins that control hou software behaves, kept apairt frae the code sae they're easy tae chynge.
gloss.envvar.text: A settin haundit tae a program whan it stairts, aften uised for addresses or passwirds sae they're no written intae the code.
gloss.debugging.text: Huntin doun why somethin isnae warkin, an fixin it.
gloss.pairing.text: Twa fowk (or a body an an AI) warkin on the same code thegither, ane typin an ane checkin.
gloss.docs.text: Written explanations o hou somethin warks or hou tae uise it.
gloss.readme.text: The first file tae read in a repo: whit the project is an hou tae get it rinnin.
gloss.legacy.text: An aulder system still in uise that's hard tae chynge, aften cause few fowk still unnerstaun it.
gloss.techdebt.text: Shortcuts that save time noo but mak later chynges slawer, like a loan that gaithers interest. Refactorin pays it doun.
gloss.autotest.text: A check the computer rins by itsel ilka time the code chynges, tae catch mistaks early.
gloss.manualtest.text: A body tryin the wark by haund tae see if it behaves as it should.
gloss.unittest.text: A wee automatic check o ae tiny bit o code on its ain.
gloss.integtest.text: A check that a wheen pairts wark richt thegither, no jist ane at a time.
gloss.endtoend.text: A test that acts like a real user frae stert tae feenish, sic as signin up, buyin an peyin.
gloss.uat.text: The fowk that speired for the wark try it themsels an say if it daes whit they need. AI-gile's test pile is its version o this.
gloss.regression.text: Somethin that uised tae wark but broke efter a chynge. Regression tests check that the auld things still wark.
gloss.smoke.text: A gey quick check that the main things wark at aa, for example richt efter a chynge gaes live. If it fails, stop an hae a look.
gloss.exploratory.text: Tryin the product freely an pokin at it in different weys, tae fin problems that plannit checks wad miss.
gloss.testcase.text: Ae written scenario tae try: the steps, an whit should happen.
gloss.coverage.text: Hou muckle o the code is checked by automatic tests. Mair is usually safer, but heich coverage alane disnae prove it warks weel.
gloss.testdata.text: Made-up example information uised while testin, sae naebody's real private details are exposed.
gloss.edgecase.text: An unco situation at the limits, like a tuim form or a name wi an apostrophe, whaur things aften brek.
gloss.happypath.text: The normal route whaur aathin gaes richt. Guid testin tries the unhappy paths an aa.
gloss.perftest.text: Checkin hou fast somethin is an hou weel it copes unner strain.
gloss.loadtest.text: Checkin hou a system copes whan lots o fowk uise it at aince.
gloss.sectest.text: Lookin for weaknesses that could let somebody misuise a system or see whit they shouldnae.
gloss.accesstest.text: Checkin that fowk wi different abilities can uise the product, includin wi a screen reader or jist a keyboard.
gloss.linting.text: An automatic check that spots likely mistaks an messy style in code, like a spellin checker for programs.
gloss.static.text: Checkin code for problems by readin it automatically, wioot rinnin it.
gloss.flaky.text: A test that whiles passes an whiles fails for nae clear reason, sae it cannae be fully trustit.
gloss.repro.text: Makkin a bug happen again on purpose by follaein the same steps, sae it can be studied an fixed. Writin thae steps doun is the maist uisefu pairt o a bug report.
gloss.severity.text: Hou bad a problem's effect is, frae a wee annoyance tae aathin stoppin.
gloss.devops.text: A wey o warkin whaur the fowk that build software an the fowk that rin it wark as ae team, wi lots o automation, sae chynges gae live aften an safely.
gloss.cicd.text: Aabody's chynges are jyned intae the main version aften an checked automatically ilka time (continuous integration), sae the software's aye ready tae gae live at the press o a button (continuous delivery).
gloss.contdeploy.text: Ae step further than continuous delivery: ilka chynge that passes the checks gaes live by itsel, wi nae button tae press.
gloss.pipeline.text: The automatic series o steps a chynge gaes throu on its wey tae live, like build, test, then deploy.
gloss.environment.text: Ae separate copy o the system for ae purpose, sic as ane tae build in, ane tae test in an the live ane.
gloss.devenv.text: The copy a developer warks in, aften on their ain computer, whaur brekkin things harms naebody.
gloss.testenv.text: A separate copy o the system uised jist for testin, sae the real service isnae touched.
gloss.staging.text: A last copy set up jist like live, for a final check afore a chynge gaes live.
gloss.artifact.text: The file or bundle a build produces, ready tae be storit, checkit or pit live.
gloss.hotfix.text: An urgent fix pit live quick, ootside the normal plan, cause somethin important's broken.
gloss.patch.text: A wee update that fixes a bug or shuts a security hole. Applyin security patches quick matters.
gloss.version.text: A label like 2.4.1 that says whilk release ye hae. Aften the first nummer chynges for big chynges an the last for wee fixes.
gloss.relnotes.text: A short plain list o whit chynged in a release, for the fowk that uise it, includin fixes an kent limits. Caad a changelog an aa.
gloss.flag.text: An on an aff switch for a feature, sae new wark can gae live hidden an be turned on (or aff again) wioot a new release.
gloss.rollfwd.text: Fixin a bad release by quickly pittin oot a new, correctit version instead o gaun back tae the auld ane.
gloss.canary.text: Pittin a chynge live for a wee group first, an for aabody only aince it looks fine. Named efter the canaries miners took unnergrund as an early warnin.
gloss.bluegreen.text: Keepin twa copies o the live system an switchin fowk ower tae the new ane in ae go, sae ye can switch straucht back if it gaes wrang.
gloss.zerodown.text: Pittin a new version live wioot the service iver stoppin for its users.
gloss.chgenable.text: Helpin chynges succeed: weighin the risk, gettin the richt approval an pickin a guid time. Caad change management an aa.
gloss.cab.text: A group that looks ower important chynges an agrees whether an whan they can gae ahead.
gloss.stdchange.text: A law-risk chynge duin the same tried an testit wey ilka time, sae it's approvit in advance.
gloss.normchange.text: A chynge that needs checkit an approvit afore it gaes ahead.
gloss.emergchange.text: A chynge that maun happen richt awa tae fix or stop serious trouble, wi a quicker approval tae match.
gloss.automation.text: Gettin the computer tae dae a repeated job by itsel, sae it's quicker an duin the same wey ilka time.
gloss.infra.text: The machines, networks an services that software rins on.
gloss.iac.text: Describin yer servers an settins in files kept wi the code, sae they can be rebiggit exactly the same wey ilka time.
gloss.cloud.text: Rentin computers, storage an services frae a big provider ower the internet, instead o ownin the machines yersel.
gloss.provider.text: A company that rents oot computin ower the internet, sic as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
gloss.hosting.text: Whaur yer app or wabsite lives an rins sae fowk can reach it, usually rentit frae a company.
gloss.domain.text: The web address fowk type, like example.com. Ye rent it by the year, sae it maun be renewed.
gloss.dns.text: Short for domain name system: the internet's address beuk, that turns a name like example.com intae the address o the richt computer.
gloss.container.text: A sealed package haudin an app an aathin it needs, sae it rins the same on ony computer. Docker is the best kent tool.
gloss.vm.text: A pretend computer rinnin inside a real ane, sae ae big machine can act as mony.
gloss.serverless.text: Rinnin code wioot lookin efter ony servers yersel: the provider rins it whan needit an ye pey for whit ye uise.
gloss.lb.text: Somethin that spreids visitors across a wheen servers, sae nae single ane gets owerwhelmed.
gloss.cache.text: A haundy store o recent results kept close by, sae the same thing disnae hae tae be fetched or warked oot again. Clearin it can fix pages that look oot o date.
gloss.cdn.text: A warldwide set o servers haudin copies o yer pages an pictures near yer visitors, sae they load quick.
gloss.migration.text: Muivin data or systems frae an auld setup tae a new ane, or carefully chyngin hou a database is laid oot.
gloss.svcmgmt.text: Aathin involved in keepin a service uisefu an warkin for the fowk that rely on it, day efter day.
gloss.itil.text: A widely uised guide tae guid service management, coverin things like incidents, problems an chynges. The name aince stuid for IT Infrastructure Library.
gloss.itsm.text: Rinnin technology as a service for fowk, wi clear weys tae handle requests, incidents, chynges an improvements.
gloss.managed.text: A service somebody else rins an looks efter for ye, unner an agreement aboot hou weel it maun wark.
gloss.svcowner.text: The body that answers for a service as a hail: hou weel it warks, whit it costs an hou it improves.
gloss.sla.text: A written promise tae customers aboot hou weel a service'll wark, like “up 99.9% o the time” or “answered inside an oor”, aften wi siller back if it's broken.
gloss.slo.text: The team's ain target for hou weel a service should wark ower a period, usually set a bit stricter than the SLA tae be safe.
gloss.sli.text: The actual measurement ye check agin a target, like the share o visits that loaded fine.
gloss.uptimepct.text: Hou muckle o the time a service is warkin, usually as a percentage. 99.9% still lets aboot 43 meenits doun a month.
gloss.availability.text: Whether fowk can uise a service whan they need it, aften measured as uptime.
gloss.downtime.text: Time whan a service isnae warkin or is switched aff, plannit or no.
gloss.errorbudget.text: The wee amoont o failure yer reliability target allous. While some is left ye can tak risks wi chynges; aince it's uised up, ye slaw doun.
gloss.outage.text: A time whan a service is doun or badly broken for its users.
gloss.degraded.text: Warkin, but badly: slaw, or wi some pairts no warkin.
gloss.monitoring.text: Watchin a service automatically aa the time, sae problems are spottit, ideally afore users notice.
gloss.observability.text: Hou weel ye can tell whit's gaun on inside a system frae the ootside, uisin its logs, nummers an traces.
gloss.log.text: A rinnin diary a program keeps o whit it's daein, uised tae wark oot whit gaed wrang.
gloss.trace.text: A record o hou ae request traivels throu the different pairts o a system, step by step, shawin whaur it slawed doun.
gloss.latency.text: Hou lang somethin taks tae answer, like the wait atween clickin an the page appearin.
gloss.alert.text: An automatic message that somethin needs attention, like the wabsite no answerin.
gloss.alertfatigue.text: Whan there's sae mony alerts that fowk stert ignorin them, includin the important anes.
gloss.dashboard.text: A screen shawin the maist important nummers an statuses at a glance.
gloss.paging.text: Urgently ringin or wakkin the on-call body aboot a problem.
gloss.escalation.text: Bringin in somebody wi mair skill or authority whan an issue cannae be sortit at the current level, or no fast eneuch.
gloss.triage.text: Quickly sortin incomin issues by hou urgent an important they are, sae the warst gets haunled first.
gloss.impact.text: Hou muckle somethin affects fowk: hou mony, an hou badly.
gloss.urgency.text: Hou quick somethin needs deelt wi. Impact an urgency thegither set the priority.
gloss.plevels.text: Labels for hou urgent an issue is. P1 is the maist serious an needs action straucht awa.
gloss.queue.text: The list o requests an incidents waitin tae be pickit up.
gloss.tiers.text: Levels o support: first line taks the cry an fixes simple things; second line has deeper skills for harder anes. Some caa them tier 1 an tier 2.
gloss.ic.text: The ae body that leads the response tae an incident, sae aabody kens wha decides an wha daes whit.
gloss.responsetime.text: Hou lang it taks afore somebody first taks up a request or incident.
gloss.resolution.text: Hou lang it taks tae fully sort oot a request or incident, frae report tae fixed.
gloss.mttr.text: On average, hou lang it taks tae get a service warkin again efter it breks. MTTR can mean slichtly different things, sae say whit ye measure.
gloss.mtbf.text: On average, hou lang a service rins afore somethin breks.
gloss.cmdb.text: The list o aa yer configuration items an hou they connect, sae ye can see whit depends on whit.
gloss.asset.text: Onythin o value ye own or pey for tae rin the service, like a laptop, a software licence or a domain.
gloss.capplan.text: Makkin shair there'll be eneuch computer pooer, storage an fowk for whit's comin.
gloss.scaling.text: Copin wi mair users by giein a machine mair pooer (scaling up) or addin mair machines (scaling out).
gloss.bcp.text: Plans for keepin the important things gaun whan somethin big gaes wrang, like losin an office, a key supplier or the computers.
gloss.dr.text: The plan an tools for gettin a service back efter somethin serious, like losin a hail data centre.
gloss.rto.text: The langest a service can be doun efter a disaster afore it maun be warkin again.
gloss.rpo.text: Hou muckle recent data ye could afford tae lose, measured in time. An RPO o ae oor means backups at least ilka oor.
gloss.redundancy.text: Haein spares ready, like a second server, sae ae failure disnae stop the service.
gloss.failover.text: Switchin ower tae a spare system by itsel whan the usual ane fails.
gloss.spof.text: Ae pairt that taks aathin doun wi it whan it breks, cause there's nae spare.
gloss.maintwin.text: A plannit time whan a service micht be pauset or slaw for upkeep, annooncet tae users in advance.
gloss.handover.text: Passin wark, knawledge an responsibility tae anither body or team, sae nocht gets drappit.
gloss.kb.text: A collection o help airticles an answers, for users an for the team.
gloss.csat.text: A score frae users sayin hou happy they were, aften speired efter a request is closed.
gloss.supplier.text: An ootside company ye rely on, like yer hostin provider. Caad a vendor or third party an aa.
gloss.retire.text: Switchin a service aff for guid, safely: tellin its users, dealin wi its data an access, an stoppin its costs.
gloss.eol.text: Whan a product stops gettin updates or support frae its makker, sae it should be replaced.
gloss.cybersec.text: Protectin systems an data frae bein broken intae, stown or damaged.
gloss.authn.text: Checkin wha somebody is, usually wi a passwird or a code. Aften shortened tae authn.
gloss.authz.text: Checkin whit somebody's allooed tae dae aince ye ken wha they are. Aften shortened tae authz.
gloss.mfa.text: Loggin in wi twa or mair proofs, like a passwird plus a code on yer phone. Caad two-factor (2FA) an aa.
gloss.sso.text: Loggin in aince tae get intae mony systems, like uisin yer wark accoont aawhaur.
gloss.pwmgr.text: An app that creates strang passwirds an minds them for ye.
gloss.secret.text: A passwird, key or ither private code a program uises tae get intae somethin. It maunna iver be shared or written intae the code.
gloss.apikey.text: A secret code that lets a program uise anither service's API, an shaws wha's uisin (an peyin for) it.
gloss.accesstoken.text: A temporary pass that proves a program's allooed in, sae it disnae need yer passwird ilka time. No the same as an AI token.
gloss.encryption.text: Scramblin information sae only somebody wi the richt key can read it.
gloss.https.text: The secure wey web pages traivel, shawn by the padlock in yer browser, sae naebody atween can read or chynge them.
gloss.cert.text: A digital ID caird that lets a wabsite prove wha it is an uise HTTPS. It expires, sae it maun be renewed.
gloss.permissions.text: The rules for wha can see or chynge whit.
gloss.leastpriv.text: Giein ilka body or program only the access they truly need, for only as lang as they need it.
gloss.rbac.text: Giein access by role, like viewer or editor, raither than body by body.
gloss.vuln.text: A weakness that somebody could uise tae brek in or cause hairm.
gloss.zeroday.text: A weakness attackers ken aboot afore the makkers hae haen ony time tae fix it.
gloss.malware.text: Hairmfu software, like viruses, made tae damage, spy or steal.
gloss.ransomware.text: Malware that locks up yer files an demands siller tae unlock them. Guid backups are the best defence.
gloss.phishing.text: Fake messages that try tae trick ye intae giein awa passwirds or siller, or openin somethin hairmfu.
gloss.socialeng.text: Trickin fowk, raither than computers, intae giein access, like a fake cry frae “IT support”.
gloss.firewall.text: A guaird that decides whilk network traffic may come in or gae oot.
gloss.vpn.text: Short for virtual private network: a private, scramblit link ower the internet, aften uised tae reach wark systems safely.
gloss.ddos.text: Floodin a service wi sae muckle fake traffic that real fowk cannae uise it. DDoS means it comes frae mony computers at aince.
gloss.pentest.text: Hirin friendly experts tae try tae brek in, sae weaknesses are fund afore real attackers fin them.
gloss.audit.text: A carefu check o hou weel somethin's protectit, agin a list o guid practice.
gloss.threatmodel.text: Thinkin throu wha micht attack somethin, hou, an whit ye wad dae tae stop them.
gloss.breach.text: Whan private information gets oot tae fowk that shouldnae hae it, or is loast or chynged wioot permission.
gloss.pii.text: Ony information aboot a body that can be identifiet, like a name, email address or location. Caad PII an aa.
gloss.gdpr.text: The European law on personal data (the UK has its ain version): collect only whit ye need, keep it safe, an let fowk see or delete theirs.
gloss.dataprot.text: Lookin efter personal data properly an within the law.
gloss.privacypolicy.text: A public page sayin whit personal data ye collect, why, an whit ye dae wi it.
gloss.consent.text: A body's clear, free aye tae their data bein uised in a pairticular wey. They can tak it back at ony time.
gloss.cookie.text: A wee file a wabsite saves in yer browser tae mind things, like bein loggit in. Some need yer consent first.
gloss.minimisation.text: Collectin an keepin only the personal data ye really need for the job.
gloss.retention.text: Hou lang data is kept afore it's deleted. Keepin it nae langer than needit is safer an aften the law.
gloss.anon.text: Chyngin data sae naebody can reasonably be identifiet frae it ony mair.
gloss.pseudo.text: Swappin names an ither details for codes, wi a key kept apairt tae link them back. It's still personal data.
gloss.dpa.text: A contract sayin hou a supplier can haunle personal data on yer behauf.
gloss.dpia.text: A carefu look, afore ye stert, at hou a plan tae uise personal data could affect fowk an hou tae lower the risks.
gloss.auditlog.text: A record o wha did whit an whan, sae actions can be checked efter.
gloss.compliance.text: Follaein the laws, rules an staundards that apply tae ye, an bein able tae shaw that ye dae.
gloss.iso.text: A weel kent international staundard for managin information security. Companies can be certifiet agin it.
gloss.soc.text: A US report, checkit by ootside auditors, shawin a company looks efter customer data properly.
gloss.ai.text: Computer systems that dae things we usually think need a body, like writin, answerin questions or recognisin pictures.
gloss.ml.text: A wey o makkin computers lairn patterns frae lots o examples, instead o giein them exact rules.
gloss.model.text: The trained “brain” o an AI system, biggit by lairnin frae huge nummers o examples. Models differ in skill, speed an price.
gloss.llm.text: An AI model trained on vast amoonts o text, sae it can read an write leid.
gloss.genai.text: AI that creates new things, like text, pictures or code, raither than only sortin or spottin them.
gloss.chatbot.text: A program ye talk wi in everyday leid, by typin or speakin.
gloss.prompt.text: Whit ye gie an AI: yer question or instructions, plus onythin ye haund it. Clearer prompts usually get better answers.
gloss.prompteng.text: The skill o writin prompts that get reliable, uisefu results.
gloss.sysprompt.text: Background instructions an AI gets afore the conversation stairts, settin its role an rules. They weigh mair than whit ye type.
gloss.context.text: Aathin the AI can see while it warks: the instructions, yer messages, files it has read an earlier replies.
gloss.ctxwin.text: Hou muckle an AI can keep in mind at aince, measured in tokens. Ayont that, aulder pairts get drappit or summarisit.
gloss.session.text: Ae warkin blether wi an AI, frae stert tae feenish. A new session stairts wi a fresh memory.
gloss.memory.text: Notes an AI keeps atween sessions, sae it minds yer preferences an past decisions.
gloss.hallucination.text: Whan an AI says somethin that soonds shair o itsel but is made up or wrang. Check important facts.
gloss.training.text: Teachin a model by shawin it huge nummers o examples, afore onybody uises it.
gloss.trainingdata.text: The examples a model lairnt frae. Its knawledge stops at the date that data wis collectit.
gloss.cutoff.text: The date an AI's built-in knawledge ends. It winnae ken aboot later things unless it looks them up.
gloss.finetune.text: Extra trainin o an existin model on yer ain examples, tae mak it better at ae particular job.
gloss.inference.text: An AI model actually bein uised tae answer somethin, raither than bein trained.
gloss.tooluse.text: An AI bein able tae dae things, no jist talk: rin commands, read files or seirch the web, throu tools the app gies it.
gloss.subagent.text: A helper AI that a main AI hauns a smaaer job tae, an gets the result back frae.
gloss.multiagent.text: A wheen AIs warkin thegither on ae bit o wark, ilk wi its ain pairt, like a wee team.
gloss.autonomy.text: Hou muckle an AI may dae on its ain afore it has tae spier at a body.
gloss.hitl.text: Keepin a body involved tae check or approve whit the AI daes at key pynts. In AI-gile that's you.
gloss.guardrails.text: Limits an checks that keep an AI's actions safe, like needin approval afore onythin gaes live. They lower the risk o mistaks, but dinnae rule them oot.
gloss.rag.text: Lettin an AI look things up in yer ain documents afore it answers, sae its answers rest on yer facts.
gloss.embedding.text: Turnin text intae a list o nummers that catches its meanin, sae a computer can fin things that mean similar things.
gloss.vectordb.text: A database biggit tae seirch thae lists o nummers (embeddings), tae fin material wi a similar meanin.
gloss.mcp.text: A common wey tae plug tools an data sources intae AI apps, sae an AI can uise them.
gloss.temperature.text: A settin for hou adventurous an AI's answers are. Laich gies steadier, mair predictable answers; heich gies mair varied anes. Neither maks it aye richt.
gloss.multimodal.text: Able tae wark wi mair than ae kind o information, sic as text, pictures an soond.
gloss.evals.text: A plannit test o hou weel an AI daes on chosen examples, sae ye can compare models or prompts.
gloss.bias.text: Whan an AI (or a body) leans unfairly ae wey, aften cause o whit it lairnt frae.
gloss.responsible.text: Uisin AI fairly, safely an honestly, wi fowk still answerable for the results.
gloss.injection.text: A trick whaur hidden instructions in a web page or file try tae mak an AI dae somethin its user didnae spier for.
gloss.ratelimit.text: A cap on hou mony requests ye may send tae a service in a set time. Gae ower it an ye hae tae wait.
gloss.usagelimit.text: Hou muckle AI wark yer plan allous in a period, efter whilk it pauses or costs mair.
gloss.vibe.text: Biggin software maistly by describin whit ye want tae an AI an lettin it write the code.
gloss.budget.text: The amoont o siller set aside for somethin.
gloss.costest.text: A best guess at whit somethin'll cost afore ye stert.
gloss.roi.text: Whit ye get back compared wi whit ye pit in. If it's positive, it wis worth it.
gloss.tco.text: Aathin somethin really costs ower its hail life, no jist the price tae buy it: rinnin, support, upgrades an finally retirin it.
gloss.capex.text: CapEx is siller spent up front on things ye keep; OpEx is ongaun spendin, like monthly bills.
gloss.subscription.text: Peyin regularly, usually monthly or yearly, tae keep uisin somethin.
gloss.saas.text: Software ye uise online an pey for by subscription, while the makker rins it for ye.
gloss.payg.text: Peyin only for whit ye uise, like cloud computin or AI tokens.
gloss.overage.text: Uise abune whit yer plan includes, that can cost extra.
gloss.billingalert.text: A message whan spendin or uise reaches a level ye chose. It warns ye, but disnae aye stop further chairges.
gloss.freetier.text: A free level o a peyed service, wi limits. Haundy for stertin oot.
gloss.pricing.text: The different packages a service sells, ilk wi its ain price an limits.
gloss.licence.text: The rules for hou ye may uise, copy, chynge or share somethin somebody else made, sic as software, fonts or pictures.
gloss.opensource.text: Software whase code onybody can read, uise an aften chynge for free, unner the rules o its licence.
gloss.osslicence.text: The rules that come wi open source code. Some let ye dae near-haund onythin (like MIT); some ask ye tae share yer chynges an aa (like GPL).
gloss.proprietary.text: Owned by a company an no free tae copy or chynge. The opposite o open source.
gloss.copyright.text: The legal richt o a creator tae control copies o their wark, includin code an writin.
gloss.ip.text: Ideas an creations the law treats as owned, like code, designs, names an logos.
gloss.tos.text: The rules ye agree tae whan ye uise a service.
gloss.contract.text: A written agreement atween twa sides that the law'll back up.
gloss.sow.text: A document settin oot exactly whit wark'll be duin, by whan an for hou muckle.
gloss.fixedprice.text: An agreed price for the hail job, hooiver lang it taks.
gloss.tm.text: Peyin for the oors really warked an the things really uised, raither than a set price.
gloss.invoice.text: A bill askin for peyment for wark duin or guids supplied.
gloss.lockin.text: Whan muivin awa frae a supplier is sae hard or costly that ye're stuck wi them.
gloss.procurement.text: The process o choosin an buyin frae suppliers.
gloss.servicecredit.text: Siller back or a discoont ye get whan a supplier misses its SLA.

tour.firststeps.text: A wee list tae get ye gaun: mak a project, add a caird, invite a pal. Ilka ane ticks itsel when ye dae it. Hide it ance ye ken yer wey.

gloss.ci.text: Ae thing yer service depends on, like a server, a domain, a certificate, a key or a supplier. 🗂️ Configuration items lists them fer ilka service, sae ye can see whit an incident affects an whit needs renewin or a backup.
gloss.expiry.text: The date somethin stops warkin unless it's renewed, like a wabsite's security certificate or its web address. AI-gile watches thae dates an maks ae caird tae renew ilka ane 30 days afore, sae nocht stops by surprise.
gloss.desk.text: Whaur questions an reports fae the fowk uisin yer service come in. AI-gile sorts ilka ane intae a request, an incident or an idea, an says sae when it looks like somethin awready reportit.
gloss.svcrequest.text: Somebody askin fer somethin ordinar, like a new accoont or a wee bit help, raither than reportin that somethin's broke. It waits its turn; an incident gangs first.
gloss.svcreview.text: A look back at ae month o a service: incidents opened an fixed, hoo quick fowk got an answer, uptime an tokens uised. The Monthly review shows it fer ilka service.
gloss.accessreview.text: Checkin ilka 90 days wha can still get in: share links, friends' roles an saved passwirds an keys. Ye keep or remove ilka ane, sae auld access disnae linger.
gloss.improvements.text: Awthing the team decidit tae get better at, in ae place: retro suggestions, review actions an problem fixes, ilka ane wi its status. Find it unner 📈 Improvements.
gloss.tokencap.text: A monthly limit on the tokens a service’s agents can uise. At 80% ye get a warnin; at 100% their backgrund wark waits till next month or till ye raise the cap.
dc.setup.intro: Talk tae an agent fae Discord, as easy as on the board. Optional.
dc.guide.1.html: Gang tae discord.com/developers/applications an click New Application. Name it efter the agent.
dc.guide.2.html: Open Bot in the left menu, then Reset Token an copy it. It's shown jist the ance.
dc.guide.3.html: Still on Bot: nocht else tae switch on. Direct messages need nae special permission.
dc.guide.4.html: Paste the token ablow, pick wha the bot talks tae an press Save.
dc.guide.5.html: Add the bot tae a server ye're in: efter savin, press 1. Add the bot tae yer server (a bot can only be messaged if ye share a server wi it).
dc.guide.6.html: Press Link my Discord, then in that server click the bot in the member list, choose Message an send it the code. (Nae code needit if ye'd raither paste yer User ID: Discord Settings > Advanced, Developer Mode, richt-click yer name, Copy User ID.)

prac.intro: Fower steps, aw on this caird. Ilka ane ticks itsel when it's duin. Nae AI, nocht real breks.
prac.major.hint: Nae guest can say they're comin, sae this hurts awbody that uises the service: that maks it a major incident. Click 🚨 Major on this caird. On a real service it wauks the on-call agent.
prac.close.hint: Mak on ye fund the cause: last nicht's update lost the form's database password. Pittin it back is the fix (a quick wey roond it till then wad be a workaround). Noo muive the caird tae Duin (⋯ Muive tae) an answer the three post-mortem questions.

guide.inc.hi:
- An **incident** 🔥 is a caird fer "it's broke the noo". It jumps the queue an has a reid edge.
- Closin it asks three short questions: whit happened, why, whit we chynge.
- If the same thing breks again, group the incidents unner ae **problem** 🧩 wi its root cause an a workaround.
- The real fix gangs throu a chynge request.
guide.inc.steps:
1. Raise the incident: **New caird**, type **🔥 incident**.
2. Fix it first. Uise the workaround if the problem caird has ane.
3. Muive it tae Duin. Fill in **Whit happened**, **Why**, **Whit we chynge**, then **Duin**.
4. Happened afore? Ask yer lead tae group the incidents unner a **🧩 problem** caird (the commands are unner *Fer agents*).
5. The problem caird shows the **Root cause**, the **Workaround**, the incidents an the chynge request.
6. Later incidents jine the same problem; the caird lists them aw.
7. Raise a chynge request fer the fix. The problem bides open till that chynge is duin.
guide.inc.full:
- **Why it maitters:** an incident is aboot gettin back tae normal fast. A problem is aboot the cause. Mixin them means ye fecht the same fire ower an ower.
- **Incident:** the post-mortem has nae blame. It says whit happened, why, an whit chynges sae it disnae repeat. A risk fae the risk register that comes true files an incident fer ye.
- **Problem:** ae cause, mony incidents. Root cause is the reason ahint the reason (no "the server wis doon" but "the deploy script skips the tests"). The workaround is whit onybody daes till the fix ships.
- **Linkin:** an incident belangs tae ae problem. The link shows on baith cairds. Linkin it tae anither problem muives it.
- **Chynge request:** the fix is a chynge like ony ither, wi a reason, a risk an a wey back. The problem bides open till that chynge is duin.
- **Guid habits:** look at open problems at ilka retro; if three incidents share a cause, mak the problem; keep workarounds short eneuch tae follae while stressed.
guide.inc.agents:
- Raise an incident: `aigile add <proj> "Site is down" --type incident`
- Mak a problem: `aigile problem <proj> add "Deploys break the site" --incidents AIG-1,AIG-2`
- Cause an workaround: `aigile problem <proj> AIG-9 --cause "..." --workaround "..."`
- Link a later incident: `aigile problem <proj> AIG-9 link AIG-12`
- Link the chynge request: `aigile problem <proj> AIG-9 --change AIG-20`
guide.svc.hi:
- Tell the board whit projects are **services**: whit they offer, wha uises them an their web address. The board then watches the address fer ye.
- When a service stops answerin, the board raises **ae incident** by itsel. A caird that waits ower lang shows a reid ⏰ "reply by" clock.
- A richt bad incident gets the **🚨 Major** button: ae click wauks the richt agent an tells ye. A public status page shows friends whit's up.
- Whit ye learn is kept: **🧩 Known errors**, **📖 Runbooks** (hoo tae fix X) an a **📝 Post-incident review** on ilka major incident.
- Keep an ee on the **🗂️ Items** yer service stands on (expiry dates, backups), the **🔐 Access review** ilka 90 days, **🚀 Releases**, the **📈 Improvements** list an, ance a month, the **📆 Review** (wi an optional monthly token cap).
guide.svc.steps:
1. On the project board click **🎨 Look**. In the **Project settings** dialog find the **🛎️ Service** section. Tick **This project is a service** an fill in whit it offers, wha uises it an its web address.
2. Choose the **On-call agent** (the lead by default) an tick **Public** if friends can see it on the status page. If ye like, type a **Monthly token cap** sae ae project cannae eat the hale budget. Click **Save**.
3. Look at the project's dot on **Hame**: green means the address answers. If it stops answerin, an incident caird appears by itsel.
4. Open that incident caird. A bad ane? Click **🚨 Major**. Click **End major incident** when it's ower.
5. Cairds that wait ower lang show a reid ⏰. Open them first. The inbox filter **Desk: incidents** shows jist incidents fae friends an the feedback form.
6. Click **⋯ Mair** on the board, then **🗂️ Items**. Click **+ Add item** fer ilka server, domain, certificate, key, repo or supplier. Add an expiry date an, fer data, whaur it's backed up an hoo aften. Click **Backed up the day** efter ilka backup.
7. On an incident caird, look at the **📖 Runbooks** box: it lists the hoo-tae notes that match. Click **Open** tae read ane.
8. Efter a major incident is duin, its caird shows **📝 Post-incident review**. Read the timeline, then click **Mak a caird** next tae ilka thing worth chyngin.
9. Click **⋯ Mair**, then **🧩 Known errors** tae see problems that hae a workaround. Click **🚀 Releases**, type a name like v1.3 an click **🚀 New release** tae gaither the duin cairds intae notes. **↩ Roll back** files an undae checklist caird.
10. Click **⋯ Mair**, then **📆 Review** ance a month: uise **← Earlier** an **Later →** tae chynge month, an **✍️ Summary** fer a twa-line summary fae the on-call agent.
11. Click **⋯ Mair**, then **📈 Improvements** (forby in the **❓ Help** menu) tae see retro ideas, review actions an problem fixes in ae list. In **Setup**, click **Run access review noo** tae see wha can get in, then **Keep** or **Tak awa** fer ilka ane.
guide.svc.full:
- **Service details:** in **🎨 Look**, **Project settings**, **🛎️ Service** ye say whit a project offers, tae wha, at whit web address an wha's on call. Jist projects ye tick coont as services.
- **Uptime dot:** ilka few minutes the board asks the web address if it's alive. Green is fine; reid means it didnae answer. Three misses in a raw open ae incident, never a pile, an a comment says when it wis back ("Up again efter N min").
- **Reply-by ⏰:** ilka kind o caird has a time tae reply by (an incident aboot an oor, a friend request a couple o days, a bug aboot a week). Late cairds gang reid an the daily brief lists them. These are aims, no promises.
- **🚨 Major:** fer an incident that hurts mony users or risks siller or data. Ae click pits the swarm on, wauks the on-call agent, sends ye ae note an asks fer a "Status:" comment ilka 30 minutes.
- **Status page:** a public page shows ilka public service as green, orange or reid wi the latest status line. It never shows caird text, jist the line you or the agent chose.
- **Service desk:** reports fae friends an the feedback form are sortit intae **Request**, **Incident** or **Idea**. The inbox filter (**Desk: aw**, **Desk: requests** an sae on) shows ae kind. A report that looks like a caird ye awready hae says "looks like AIG-12" wi a **Link** button.
- **🧩 Known errors:** a problem wi a kent cause an a workaround that isnae duin yet. They're listed per project an fer aw projects, an gang intae ilka agent's brief, sae naebody howks intae it twice.
- **📖 Runbooks:** short step-by-step notes on hoo tae fix a thing. An incident caird shows the anes that match its title. Efter a review, the agent can propose a new runbook an ye say Go or Nae yet.
- **📝 Post-incident review:** efter a major incident is duin, the agent writes a **Timeline**, **Whit helped** an **Whit tae chynge**. Ilka action becomes a caird wi **Mak a caird**. If nae agent is free, ye write it yersel.
- **🗂️ Items:** the list o things a service stands on, wi a **Kind** (server, domain, certificate, key, repo, supplier, ither). Ilka ane can hae links tae cairds or web addresses. A key is jist its name fae Secrets, never the key itsel. Incident an chynge cairds can show whit they **Affect**.
- **Expiry an backups:** ilka day the board checks expiry dates an backup age. A caird appears afore somethin rins oot or when a backup is ower auld, an ance a month a restore-test caird minds ye that a backup ye never tried tae restore is jist a hope.
- **Server health:** the board watches CPU, memory an disk on yer servers an raises an upgrade caird afore they fill up.
- **🔐 Access review:** ilka 90 days ae caird lists share links, friends' roles an kept secrets (names only), ilka ane wi **Keep** or **Tak awa**. Run it noo fae **Setup**.
- **🚀 Releases:** a release is a named bundle o the cairds that got duin since the last ane, wi short notes. **↩ Roll back** files a checklist caird wi the undae steps.
- **📈 Improvements:** retro suggestions, review actions an problem fixes in ae list, filterable by project, sae guid ideas dinnae get lost atween retros.
- **📆 Monthly review:** ae page per service fer ae month: incidents opened an closed, average time tae fix, cairds that met their reply-by target, uptime, tokens uised an server peaks. Open it fae **⋯ Mair → 📆 Review** or fae **Project settings → Service**.
- **Monthly token cap:** in **Project settings → Service** ye can set a monthly limit o tokens. At 80% the daily brief warns ye; at 100% backgrund runs fer that project wait till next month or till ye raise the cap. Yer ain Waken still warks.
- **Guid habits:** fill in the service details first, keep the web address richt, look at the status dot ilka day, write up ilka major incident an check the improvements list efter ilka retro, an read the monthly review while the month's still fresh.
guide.svc.agents:
- Raise an incident: `aigile add <proj> "Site is down" --type incident`
- Problem cause an workaround: `aigile problem <proj> AIG-9 --cause "..." --workaround "..."`
- Configuration items: `aigile ci <proj>` lists them; `aigile ci <proj> add <kind> <name>` adds ane
- Runbooks: `aigile runbook <proj>` lists them; `aigile runbook <proj> <name>` prints ane
- Major incident (owner or lead): `aigile major <proj> <incident id> --as NAME`; run it again tae end it
- Post-incident review: `aigile pir <proj> <incident id> --timeline ".." --helped ".." --actions "one | two" --as NAME`
- Runbook fae a review: `aigile pir-runbook <proj> <incident id> <name> --text ".." --as NAME`
- Releases: `aigile release <proj>` lists; `aigile release <proj> <name> --as NAME` maks ane; add `rollback` tae undae it
guide.msg.hi:
- **💬 Messages**, at the tap o the left rail, hauds aw yer chats: project leads, friends, agent groups an ilka project's Meeting Room. The filters **🤖 Agents**, **🙋 Fowk** an **🎥 Meeting Rooms** show ae kind.
- A **DM** is a private chat wi ae lead or ae friend. Chats wi friends are encryptit on the wey an on this computer.
- A **group** pits twa or mair agents in ae chat: write ance an ilka ane o them answers.
- In a friend's chat, **📞 Call** sterts a voice or video call, wi **🖥️ Share screen**. Ilka project's Meeting Room has its ain **🎥 Join call**.
- Mic or camera blocked? Allow it in the browser's address bar. Ye can aye still listen.
guide.msg.steps:
1. Click **💬 Messages** at the tap o the left rail. Pick a filter tae see jist **🤖 Agents**, **🙋 Fowk** or **🎥 Meeting Rooms**.
2. Click a project's lead tae talk tae that team direct. Type an press Enter; the lead answers in the same chat.
3. Click a friend unner **🙋 Fowk** tae chat wi them. A friend shows up here ance they've jined wi yer invite.
4. Tae ask a wheen agents at ance, click **＋ New group**, gie it a name, tick twa or mair agents an click **Mak**.
5. In a friend's chat click **📞 Call**. Yer friend sees ye're cawin an clicks tae join. Uise **🔇 Mute**, **📷 Camera on** an **🖥️ Share screen**, an **Leave call** when ye're duin.
6. Unner **🎥 Meeting Rooms**, open a project's room tae talk tae its hale team in ae chat. Click **🎥 Join call** fer its voice or video call.
7. The first time, the browser asks fer the microphone: click **Allow**. Said no by mistak? Click the icon at the stert o the address bar, allow the microphone an caw again.
guide.msg.full:
- **Ae place fer ilka chat:** **💬 Messages** lists leads, friends, groups an Meeting Rooms thegither, newest first. The filters jist chynge whit ye see; nocht is muived or deletit.
- **Leads:** ilka project has a lead. Their chat is the quickest wey tae ask that team somethin wioot makkin a caird. Ilka answer is an agent run, sae it uises tokens.
- **Friends:** a friend rins their ain AI-gile. Yer DMs gang atween yer twa boards, encryptit, an are kept encryptit on this computer forby. Replies, reactions an typin dots wark like ony chat app.
- **Groups:** you an twa or mair agents, fae ony project. Ilka message ye write wauks ilka member ance tae reply, sae a big group uises mair tokens.
- **Meeting Rooms:** ane per project, wi the agents on its team as members, aye up tae date. The call in a Meeting Room is fer you only: friends an agents cannae join it.
- **Calls:** voice an video calls wark straucht oot the box throu AI-gile's ain call server, fer you an fer yer friend; nocht tae set up. Tae uise yer ain LiveKit server, open **Setup → Calls → Advanced**.
- **Screen share:** in a call click **🖥️ Share screen**; the browser asks whit screen, windae or tab. Click **🖥️ Stop sharin** tae stop.
- **Microphone, camera an speaker:** the call panel has a chooser fer ilka ane, handy wi a heidset or a seicont camera.
- **When the mic or camera winnae wark:** "blocked" means the browser said no: allow it in the address bar. "Not found" means nocht's plugged in or switched on. "In use by another app" means anither call app has it: close that ane. Ye can aye still listen.
- **A call that draps:** ye see "Reconnectin…" first. If it ends, check yer internet an caw again.
- **Guid habits:** uise a group or a Meeting Room fer a question tae a wheen agents insteid o copyin it, mute when ye're no talkin, an share ae windae raither than the hale screen.
